data.description: Undead within 30 feet of a marrowstone golem gain a + 2 resistance bonus on saving throws, increase the save DCs of their extraordinary and supernatural abilities by 2, and gain a + 4 bonus to channel resistance. Positive energy effects cause only half damage to a creature within the marrowstone golem's aura. Their aura particularly strengthens ghouls and ghasts, giving them a +2 bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls.
